Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model’s activation, if the named friendly model isn't on the pitch and isn't suffering the taken out condition, it may be placed on the pitch in base contact with this model.

Character Traits.name: Thuggery
Character Traits.text: While this model is within 1" of the named friendly model, Este modelo obtiene +1 DMG to playbook damage results and may add a {{KD}} playbook result to each successful attack it makes.

Character Traits.name: Pick Up
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model's activation, if this model isn't in possession of the ball and is in base contact with the friendly Avarisse, este modelo puede remove all conditions it's suffering and remove itself from the pitch.

Character Traits.name: Ready to Go
Character Traits.text: este modelo puede be allocated influence while not on the pitch.

Character Traits.name: Back to Black
Character Traits.text: Once per turn, during this model's activation, it may remove the burning condition from a friendly model within 6". If it does so, that model may immediately make a 4" dodge.

Character Traits.name: Cegared by the Light
Character Traits.text: While this model is suffering the burning condition, enemy models suffer -1 TAC while attacking this model.

Character Traits.name: Flare Out
Character Traits.text:
While this model is on the pitch, friendly models which are suffering the burning condition gain Sobrecalentamiento.
{{trait 'Sobrecalentamiento' '3" Pulse'}}

Character Traits.name: The Ladderman Cometh
Character Traits.text:
If this model is not suffering from the burning condition, it gains Alcance extendido.
{{trait 'Alcance extendido'}}

Character Traits.name: Light Goes On
Character Traits.text:
While this model is suffering from the burning condition, it gains +2 TAC and Ataque agobiante.
{{trait 'Ataque agobiante'}}

Character Traits.name: Light Goes Off
Character Traits.text: At the end of this model's activation, it may remove the burning condition from itself and then immediately make a 4" dodge.

Character Traits.name: Ring of Fire
Character Traits.text: When this model scores a goal, if it does not use Run the Length, models within this pulse obtienen la condición de quemado.

Character Traits.name: Spotlight
Character Traits.text: If this model is suffering the burning condition, it gains +1/+2 KICK and ignores engaging and intervening penalties when making a kick.

Character Traits.name: Afterglow
Character Traits.text: When this model is suffering the burning condition, when a friendly model within this aura spends MP, that model may recover 2 HP. Each model may recover HP from Afterglow only once per turn.

Character Traits.name: Now You See Me...
Character Traits.text:
While not suffering the burning condition, Este modelo obtiene Movimiento impredecible.
{{trait 'Movimiento impredecible'}}

Character Traits.name: Clumsy
Character Traits.text: Enemy models entering or starting their activations within this aura suffer the burning and poison conditions.

Character Traits.name: Flash Point
Character Traits.text: Remove the Burning condition from this model. If you do, Los modelos oponentes dentro de este pulso suffer -1"/-1" MOV.

Character Traits.name: Quién es el mas precioso
Character Traits.text: Once per turn, when targeting a friendly named model with a Jugada Característica, este modelo puede use the Jugada Característica sin gastar influencia.

Character Traits.name: Prodigio
Character Traits.text: Once per turn when Este modelo obtiene possession of the ball this model is allocated 1 influence.

Character Traits.name: Intocable
Character Traits.text: When this model scores a goal, it may immediately use Ágil sin gastar influencia.

Character Traits.name: Flame On
Character Traits.text: While this model is suffering from the burning condition, Alchemical Bomb causes 2 condition DMG instead of 1.

Character Traits.name: Fisión
Character Traits.text: When this model causes damage to an enemy model in possession of the ball, este modelo puede remove the burning condition from the enemy model. If it does, the enemy model loses possession of the ball. Perform a circular scatter with the template centred on the enemy model.

Character Traits.name: Fusión
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model’s activation, it may remove the burning or poison condition from another model within 4". If it does, models within this pulse obtienen la condición de quemado.

Character Traits.name: Rejuvenecimiento
Character Traits.text: When a friendly model within this aura recovers HP, they recover an additional 1 HP.

Character Traits.name: A la pesca
Character Traits.text: Once per turn, when this model targets itself with a Jugada Característica, it may reduce the CST of the Jugada Característica by 1.

Character Traits.name: Rellenar las juntas
Character Traits.text: este modelo puede spend influence allocated to other friendly models within this aura to pay the CST of Jugada Características.

Character Traits.name: Mal agüero
Character Traits.text: Este modelo obtiene +2 TAC while a model is suffering the taken out condition.

Character Traits.name: Paso fantasmal
Character Traits.text: When this model moves by advancing or dodging, it may pass over other models’ bases. It can’t end its movement overlapping another model’s base.

Character Traits.name: Confianza
Character Traits.text: Once during this model's activation, you may choose a friendly model within 4". The chosen model may reroll any number of dice during its next TN test this turn.

Character Traits.name: Frenesí rabioso
Character Traits.text: When this model makes a charge Durante su activación, it may do so sin gastar influencia. If it does, at the end of its activation it suffers 4 DMG.

Character Traits.name: Sed de alimaña
Character Traits.text: When another model suffers the taken out condition while within this aura, after current actions are resolved, este modelo puede recover 2 HP.

Character Traits.name: Stealthy
Character Traits.text: Enemy Jugada Características targeting this model suffer –5" RNG.

Character Traits.name: Poisoner
Character Traits.text: Each time this model dodges, after the current action is resolved, choose an enemy model within 4". The chosen model suffers the poison condition.

Character Traits.name: Chameleon
Character Traits.text: When this model returns to the pitch after suffering the taken out condition, it may treat the enemy team's deployment zone as its own.

Character Traits.name: Subsistence
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model’s activation, it may choose a friendly harvest marker within 2" and remove that marker from the pitch. If it does, este modelo puede recover 4 HP.

Character Traits.name: Bends... But Never Breaks
Character Traits.text: While this model is within 1" of a friendly log pile marker, it gains Firme. {{trait 'Firme'}}

Character Traits.name: Caber Toss
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model's activation, you may choose a friendly log pile marker within 1" of this model. Place the chosen log pile marker within 4" of this model.

Character Traits.name: Splitting Strikes
Character Traits.text: While within 1" of a friendly log pile marker, when this model makes a successful attack and selects one or more playbook damage results, choose another enemy model within this model's melee zone. The chosen model suffers 2 DMG.

Character Traits.name: Hew Do They Think They Are
Character Traits.text:
While this model is within 1" of the named friendly model or a friendly log pile marker, Este modelo obtiene Calmo.
{{trait 'Calmo'}}

Character Traits.name: Eye of the Sun Father
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model's activation, if there is a friendly log pile marker within 4" of this model, este modelo puede make a pass or use a Jugada Característica sin gastar influencia.

Character Traits.name: Synchronised
Character Traits.text: When the named friendly model receives a successful pass from this model, it may spend 1 less MP to use Pass & Move or make a Snap Shot.

Character Traits.name: Putting Out Fires
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model's activation, choose a friendly log pile marker and remove any amount of influence from friendly models within 4" of it. Then, allocate the removed influence to other friendly models within 4" of the chosen log pile marker.

Character Traits.name: Den Protector
Character Traits.text: When this model declares a charge against an enemy model that's within 1" of a friendly log pile marker, it may do so sin gastar influencia.

Character Traits.name: Hunker Down
Character Traits.text: Once per turn, while this model is within 1" of a friendly logpile marker, it may use Encourage without spending MP.

Character Traits.name: Sibling Rivalry
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during their activation, this model or the named friendly model may make a pass sin gastar influencia if the kicking model is within 1" of a friendly log pile marker.

Character Traits.name: Specialised Equipment
Character Traits.text: This model can't be selected for a team but is automatically added when the named friendly models are selected for a team. This model doesn't count towards your maximum team size allowance and is not deployed at the start of the game.

Character Traits.name: Early Risers
Character Traits.text: At the start of this model's activation, it may be placed within 1" of its current location.

Character Traits.name: Job's a Good'un
Character Traits.text: When this model suffers the taken out condition as a result of an enemy attack or play, enemy models within this model's melee zone suffer the knocked down condition. After this model is removed from the pitch, replace this model's stat card with Cross's and Cut's stat cards.
